name: Chest Opener
description: Open your chest and reverse the forward hunch of desk posture.

slides.subText: Sit up straight on the front edge of your chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Reach behind your back and interlace your fingers together or hold the lower back of your chair.
Roll your shoulders backward and gently lift your chest toward the ceiling until you feel a pull.
Hold this open position steady while taking deep, slow breaths.
Release your hands slowly and return your body to the starting upright posture.

name: Overhead reach
description: Stretch your upper back and shoulders by reaching your arms overhead.

slides.subText: Sit up straight in your chair with your feet flat on the ground and your spine aligned.
Raise both elbows to shoulder height and bend them at a 90-degree angle with palms facing forward.
Push your hands straight up toward the ceiling while keeping your shoulders relaxed and down.
Hold your arms fully extended at the top while breathing deeply to stretch your upper back.
Lower your elbows slowly back down to the 90-degree starting position at shoulder height.

name: Cross-Body Stretch
description: Release shoulder and upper-arm tension with a gentle cross-body stretch.

slides.subText: Sit tall in the center of your chair with your feet resting flat on the floor.
Extend your right arm straight out across your chest toward the left side of your body.
Hook your left forearm under your right arm to pull it closer to your body.
Hold this position steady while keeping your right shoulder pulled down away from your ear.
Lower both arms slowly to your lap and breathe out to relax the shoulder completely.
